query: select jsonb_build_object('schemas',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',n.nspname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner),'functions',(select count(*) from pg_proc p where p.pronamespace=n.oid and p.prokind='f'))) from pg_namespace n where n.nspname !~ '^pg_' and n.nspname<>'information_schema'),'pgrst_schema_setting',current_setting('pgrst.db_schemas',true),'role_schema_settings',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',case when d.setrole=0 then 'ALL' else pg_get_userbyid(d.setrole) end,'setting',s)) from pg_db_role_setting d cross join lateral unnest(d.setconfig) s where s like 'pgrst.db_schemas=%'),'cron_table',to_regclass('cron.job')::text) metadata;
